summary:
Spacequest is an interactive space mission design game that transforms complex aerospace engineering concepts into an engaging and educational experience. Players design, manage, and simulate space missions while balancing mission objectives, spacecraft configurations, scientific payloads, launch vehicles, budgets, power requirements, mass, communication systems, and orbital constraints.

The project aims to make space exploration more accessible by allowing users to experience the challenges of real-world mission planning through interactive gameplay. By combining engineering principles with simulation and decision-making, Spacequest promotes scientific curiosity, critical thinking, creativity, and STEM learning. It provides an engaging platform for students and space enthusiasts to understand how engineering decisions influence mission success.
details:
Spacequest is an interactive Space Mission Design Simulator developed to make aerospace engineering concepts more accessible through game-based learning. The project allows users to design, configure, and evaluate space missions by making decisions related to spacecraft components, scientific payloads, launch vehicles, power systems, communication systems, mass limitations, and mission budgets.

The simulator provides an interactive environment where users can explore how engineering decisions influence mission feasibility and performance. Users can configure spacecraft systems, monitor resource requirements, simulate mission outcomes, and receive feedback on mission success and engineering constraints.

Spacequest focuses on transforming complex space mission planning into an engaging educational experience. By encouraging experimentation, resource optimization, and critical thinking, the project aims to promote STEM education and inspire students to explore aerospace engineering and space science.

The initial prototype includes mission configuration, spacecraft component selection, resource monitoring, mission evaluation, and a mission report interface. Future development includes enhanced orbital mechanics, realistic mission models, and integration of NASA datasets and scientific resources.

The project was designed as an accessible educational platform that connects space science with interactive engineering simulation.
